recentItems.title: Arteta reacts to Guimaraes and Saka's strikes 🙌 | Bench Cam | Sunderland 0-2 Arsenal | EPL
recentItems.description:
Mike Arteta oversaw an enthralling 2-0 victory against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light, and you can see all of his reactions in our latest Bench Cam episode!

From seeing us concede a penalty to watching Bruno Guimaraes bag his first goal in style, it was a game full of big moments at the Stadium of Light.
